note: Every sound the game plays. tools/sfx-generate.mjs generates the missing recordings into assets/sfx/<id>_<n>.mp3 with ELEVENLABS_API_KEY from the environment (never committed); the build embeds them and they replace the synthesized or aliased sound. Never called at play time.
